labels.name: upstream
labels.rationale: CVE advisory about the Pygments dependency, not Rich itself

items.body:
The advisory in this report concerns the Pygments dependency, not Rich itself. Rich uses Pygments for syntax highlighting, so the Pygments project is the right place to track CVE-2026-4539.

For a private vulnerability report about Rich, please follow [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/SECURITY.md) rather than a public issue.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
